title: Fiberwise relative-colimit lifting across a cocartesian relative join
statement: Use [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], relative diagrams of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone], relative joins of [def-coef-infinity-relative-join], and cocartesian fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $u:K\to C$ be a cocartesian fibration of quasicategories and $p:D\to B$ an isofibration of quasicategories (an inner fibration lifting equivalence edges with specified source). Let $J=K\star_C C$, $f:K\to D$ and $g:J\to B$ satisfy $pf=gi_K$ exactly. Suppose that for every $c\in C$ there is a $p$-colimit diagram $v_c:K_c^{\triangleright}\to D$ with $v_c|_{K_c}=f|_{K_c}$ and $pv_c=gj_c$ exactly, where $K_c=K\times_C\{c\}$ and $j_c$ is its fiber-cone map into $J$. Then there is a functor $\bar f:J\to D$ with $\bar f i_K=f$ and $p\bar f=g$ exactly such that $\bar f j_c$ is a $p$-colimit diagram for every $c$. This imposes no condition on preservation of colimits by fiber transport and no existence of any other colimits in $D$. All objects are small in a fixed sufficiently large universe.
